data.acceptance:
1. After every successful Store mutation, Thimble pushes the changed namespace to all peers in peers.toml.
2. Each push is timeout-bounded (default 30s, configurable via env).
3. Per-peer failures emit stderr warnings and update the peer-state file; the local mutation succeeds regardless.
4. Flags --no-peer-push and env THIMBLE_PEER_PUSH=off disable the broadcast for batch/single-leader scenarios.
5. Tests stub rsync and verify push semantics (success, timeout, partial failure).
